posts.author: Senator Jotan
posts.text:
Oh no what shall we do this rando from basquis just called our server bad oh despair.

Is it nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of this outrageous fortune, or shall I take arms against this sea of troubles, and by opposing end them?

Or is it better to die, to sleep no more? And by a sleep to say we end this heartache, and these thousand natural shocks that flesh is heir to? It’s a consultation devoutly to be wished. To die, to sleep.

To sleep, perchance to dream. Aye, there’s the rub. For in that sleep of death what dreams may come when we have shuffled of this mortal coil must give us pause. There’s the calamity that makes respect of so long life.

For who can bear these whips and scorns of time? The langs of despised love, the law’s delay, the insolence of office, and the spurns that patient merit of the unworthy takes.

posts.text: Fake news. I've been told it was a great election, maybe even the greatest. I've been in the senate many times, and there has never been any issues.
